nom: BLUE LIZARD AUSTRALIAN SUNSCREEN Sensitive Mineral Sunscreen Spray SPF 50+

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are overwhelmingly positive and by far the best-supported skin type in the reviews: dozens report no irritation, stinging, redness or breakouts, including some who say other sunscreens normally cause a reaction, sting their eyes, or require an antihistamine, and several use it successfully on sensitive-skinned children.

concerns.blemishes: Reviewers with acne-prone or breakout-prone skin, including some who normally break out in summer, report no new breakouts or irritation from this sunscreen; no reviewer in this set reports it causing breakouts.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness, including some who say they normally burn or react easily; the clear exception is a reviewer who applied multiple coats and still got badly sunburned, and another who was mildly red after sun exposure despite using the product.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe it as non-greasy and quick to absorb without residue; a minority disagree, describing a lingering greasy or oily feel after application, though for at least one reviewer this faded as the product finished blending in.
concerns.dehydration: A couple of reviewers say the aloe in the formula leaves their skin feeling more moisturized or nourished after use; no reviewer reports it drying out their skin.

aspects.libelle: Leaves a white cast that needs rubbing in
Blends in clear with no white cast for many
Spray can be uneven or clog in thick globs
Well tolerated and easy to apply on kids
Holds up well in water and sweat
Spray gives less product for the price than the lotion

extraits.titre: Buy this if you want to get sunburnt
extraits.texte: This is the worst sunscreen ever!! I applied multiple coats of this and any part of exposed skin got terribly sunburnt. I would give it ZERO STARS if it was possible. Complete waste of money and I'm in pain.

This is a very reputable brand with quality ingredients, however I won't be using this again. My skin looked dull and powdery. I was in the summer sun hoping for it to not only protect my skin but maybe make it look a little shiny, moisturized and nice since I have tattoos on my arms. Unfortunately, this made my arms look completely dusty, dull and powdery. If this is not a concern for you then you will love this.

I have fair sensiti e skin that burns easily in the sun. I did not break out from this product and was only slightly red after tanning in the sun. The only downside is it leaves a white finish depending on how much you use and I feel like even after I showered the product was still on my skin

extraits.titre: Best Spray sunscreen on the market
extraits.texte: Simple, sleek design and cool to the touch. This is one of my favorite NON residue leaving spray sunscreen. I have brown skin and when I spray, you can barely see it! I rub it in and go! I have very sensitive skin and this sunscreen does the job without me taking a benedryl. Barely a scent and nice that it is mineral.

extraits.titre: Gentle, lightweight mineral sunscreen that protect
extraits.texte: I have sensitive, acne- prone skin, and this mineral SPF 50 spray worked great for me. It didn't cause irritation or breakouts. It applies evenly, blends better than most mineral sunscreens, and feels lightweight without being greasy.
Great sunscreen I have sensitive skin I usually break out in the summer but using this I don't. Protects me from the sun and so can use it on my 7 year old niece.

extraits.titre: Amazing consistency and easy to apply!
extraits.texte: This sunscreen is AMAZING. Normally, mineral sunscreens are difficult to rub in, but this spray version applied clear and the coverage was great. I also found that the consistency was unlike other sprays- it actually felt matte and didn't leave skin shiny. My sensitive-skin child had no complaint about burning or discomfort when this was applied, and normally she refuses all spray sunscreens. The bottle is a great size for on the go! This is our new go to!!
